title: 第151章 化神期的存在？
slug: 黄牛中介没想到你请得动真神啊
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

季伯渊站在他旁边，见他脸色骤变，心里咯噔一下，连忙问道：“张小友，怎么了？”

张瑀没有立刻回答。

他盯着系统面板上的扫描结果，瞳孔微微缩了一下。

系统给出的信息一行一行地刷新出来，每一行都让他的眉头皱得更紧。

【扫描完成。】

【扫描结果如下——】

【通道深处存在一座地下宫殿，建于约四千年前。宫殿核心区域有一处封闭石室，石室内封印着一具棺椁。】

【棺椁材质：万年阴沉木。】

【棺椁状态：完好无损，封印仍在运转，但封印灵力已衰减至全盛时期的百分之七。】

【封印对象：未确认。棺材内能量波动极微弱，可以断定棺椁内存在活物，但无法穿透棺椁进行精确扫描。】

【威胁等级评估：极高。能在封印万年阴沉木棺中存活数千年的存在，至少也是化神期的修士或同等实力的异类生灵，不建议宿主贸然接近。】

张瑀看完最后一行字，深吸了一口气。

万年阴沉木棺，封印灵力只剩百分之七，里面还关着一个活的东西。

虽然不如上次那蛇妖的封印残余得多，但那蛇妖只是炼气期的水准。

能活上数千年的东西，最次也是个化神起步。

化神……这个层次的修行者已经拥有了改天换地的力量

如果说元婴期是一座大山的话，那么化神期便是孕育着一座又一座山脉的大陆，两者天差地别。

元婴期虽然强大，但已然还停留在“人”的层次，而化神期，已经初步接触到了“仙”的门槛。

张瑀抬起头来，看向季伯渊。

“季宗主，情况比我想象的严重。”他的语气前所未有的凝重，“通道深处有一座地下宫殿，宫殿核心有一处封闭石室，里面封着一具万年阴沉木棺。”

这话一出来，在场的几位长老脸色全都变了。

万年阴沉木，那是修真界最顶级的封禁材料。

这种木材生长在极阴之地，千年才能长一圈年轮，万年方能成材。

用它打造的棺椁，天生就能隔绝一切灵力和神识探查。

Page (1/3)

Ji Boyuan stood next to him. Seeing his sudden change in expression, his heart skipped a beat and he quickly asked: "Zhang Xiaoyou, what's wrong?"

Zhang Yu didn't answer immediately.

He stared at the scanning results on the system panel, his pupils narrowing slightly.

The information given by the system was refreshed line by line, and each line made him frown more tightly.

[Scan completed.】

[Scan results are as follows——]

[There is an underground palace deep in the passage, built about four thousand years ago.There is a closed stone chamber in the core area of ​​the palace, and a coffin is sealed in the stone chamber.】

[Coffin material: ten thousand years of dark wood.】

[Coffin status: intact, the seal is still functioning, but the seal’s spiritual power has declined to 7% of its heyday.】

[Sealed object: Unconfirmed.The energy fluctuations in the coffin are extremely weak, and it can be concluded that there are living things inside the coffin, but it is impossible to penetrate the coffin for accurate scanning.】

[Threat level assessment: extremely high.Beings that can survive for thousands of years in a gloomy wooden coffin that has been sealed for thousands of years are at least monks in the god transformation stage or alien creatures of the same strength. It is not recommended that the host approaches them rashly.】

Zhang Yu took a deep breath after reading the last line.

The wooden coffin had been darkened for thousands of years, with only 7% of its sealed spiritual power remaining, and there was still a living thing locked inside.

Although not as much as the remaining seal of the snake demon last time, the snake demon was only at the Qi refining stage.

Things that can live for thousands of years start out as individual gods.

Transformation into gods... Practitioners at this level already have the power to change the world.

If the Nascent Soul stage is a big mountain, then the Transformation stage is a continent that nurtures one mountain after another. The two are very different.

Although the Nascent Soul stage is powerful, it is still at the "human" level, while the Divine Transformation stage has initially reached the threshold of "immortal".

Zhang Yu raised his head and looked at Ji Boyuan.

"Sect Leader Ji, the situation is more serious than I thought." His tone was more solemn than ever before, "There is an underground palace deep in the passage. There is a closed stone chamber at the core of the palace, which contains a ten thousand-year-old gloomy wooden coffin."

As soon as these words came out, the faces of the elders present all changed.

Ten Thousand Years of Gloomy Wood is the top banned material in the world of cultivation.

This kind of wood grows in extremely shady places, and it takes thousands of years to grow a ring of growth, and it takes ten thousand years to become useful.

A coffin made with it is inherently insulated from all spiritual power and spiritual exploration.
